Unlike many other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] reverted to flying a standard '''[[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]'''. This starfighter had a customized paint job similar to that of Plo's ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]'' and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] ''[[Azure Angel]]'', marking the ship with distinctive blue and white stripes.

==History==
[[File:PloKoonsDelta7AetherspriteClassLightInterceptor-ROTS.png|thumb|left|180px|Plo Koon flies his light interceptor on Cato Neimoidia.]]
A [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] with a long, distinguished record of service, Plo Koon, from his seat on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], helped see the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] through many trials in its twilight years. His tendency to see things in the stark terms of simple right and wrong served him well over the years. Joined with his heightened extrasensory abilities, it lent him a clarity of vision superior to some of the other Jedi.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Titanium Series|pack=Plo Koon's Jedi Starfighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw07TSplofighter.asp}}</ref> This clarity extended to his piloting; he was a straightforward warrior who was often seen at the head of a bombing run or diving charge. He was, however, unprepared for the subtlety of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and was blown out of the sky of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] by his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] wingman, [[Jai'galaar (clone)|Captain Jag]], after the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

Earlier during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Plo Koon was gifted a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B]] that was named the ''[[Blade of Dorin/Legends|Blade of Dorin]]''.<ref name="EpGuide201">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> This ship was marked with the same color scheme and design as Skywalker's ''[[Azure Angel]]''. It is unknown why he switched from the ''Blade of Dorin'' to a standard Delta-7 starfighter.
